fourchan.description:
4chan data source for Webjutter. Boards are scraped with regular intervals because 4chan is ephemeral; posts are deleted after a certain amount of activity. Be sure to inspect the completeness of the data. 4chan data contains offensive and hateful speech. Even though most users are anonymous, be sensitive with user data.

## Search fields
You can search by:
- `resto`: The thread ID
- `num`: The post ID 
- `board`: The name of the board (e.g. 'mlp')
- `time`: The date in UNIX timestamp
- `name`: The username of the poster (mostly 'Anonymous')
- `sub`: The thread subject
- `com`: The thread body 
- `country`: The country code of the flag of the poster (only on /pol/ and /int/)

See the [4chan API documentation](https://github.com/4chan/4chan-API) for more information.
